mapper.select: SELECT p.abs_id, p.delegate_id, u.user_name as delegateUserName, to_char(p.start_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD') as startDt, to_char(p.end_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD') as endDt, p.proxy_comment, p.seq_no FROM T2000_PROXY p join t1000_account a on p.delegate_id=a.account_id join t1000_user u on a.user_no=u.user_no WHERE p.abs_id = #{accountId} and p.end_dt > SYSDATE ORDER BY p.SEQ_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T2000_PROXY (ABS_ID, DELEGATE_ID, START_DT, END_DT, PROXY_COMMENT, DEL_YN) VALUES (#{absId}, #{delegateId}, TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{proxyComment}, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT p.abs_id, p.delegate_id, u.user_name as delegateUserName, to_char(p.start_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD') as startDt, to_char(p.end_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD') as endDt, p.proxy_comment, p.seq_no, p.del_yn FROM T2000_PROXY p join t1000_account a on p.delegate_id=a.account_id join t1000_user u on a.user_no=u.user_no WHERE p.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo}
mapper.update: update T2000_PROXY set del_Yn = 'Y', update_dt=SYSDATE where seq_no=#{seqNo}
mapper.select:
SELECT p.abs_id, p.delegate_id, u.user_name AS delegateUserName, TO_CHAR(p.start_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDt, TO_CHAR(p.end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDt, p.proxy_comment, p.seq_no, p.del_yn, TO_CHAR(p.create_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createDt, TO_CHAR(p.update_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS updateDt FROM T2000_PROXY p JOIN T1000_ACCOUNT a ON p.delegate_id = a.account_id JOIN T1000_USER u ON a.user_no = u.user_no
AND p.del_yn = #{delYn}
AND p.abs_id = #{absId}
AND u.user_name LIKE '%' || #{delegateUserName} || '%'
AND p.proxy_comment LIKE '%' || #{proxyComment} || '%'
AND p.seq_no = #{seqNo}
AND p.start_dt >= TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.start_dt < TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND p.end_dt >= TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.end_dt < TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
ORDER BY p.start_dt DESC, p.abs_id DESC
ORDER BY p.end_dt DESC, p.abs_id DESC
ORDER BY p.abs_id DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
